source_policy: Author-created Korean minute-bar research proxies. Never described as exact implementations or verified returns of the referenced traders.

common.entry_gate: stop < entry_OPEN < pre_entry_target; target-entry must exceed entry times registered primary round-trip assumed cost
common.arithmetic: Decimal inputs and exact Fraction comparisons
common.ordinary_resources: CLAUDE.md existing ordinary CPU300/AS512MiB/wall1200/nice10; no inherited exceptions or automatic actual retry
common.source_binding: current raw/session/history/volume support not authenticated by this source-only contract

families.name: opening_price_level_first_pullback_multitimeframe_proxy
families.key_level: high of the six completed opening five-minute bars; frozen before breakout; an opening price-range proxy, not volume profile or arbitrary historical resistance
families.parent: first subsequent completed close strictly above frozen key_level
families.context: At parent freeze the latest two completed and available 15-minute blocks aligned to session opening, including a block ending exactly at parent end; last close > prior close and last close > session open. Incomplete blocks excluded. This is the selected arm predicate; information-removed control retains the same price candidate.
families.pullback: first later completed close below prior close; close <= key_level cancels before or through confirmation
families.impulse_target: maximum high from parent through first pullback, fixed at pullback
families.higher_low: first subsequent bar with low > pullback low and close > pullback close; high frozen at that bar
families.confirm: first later completed close strictly above frozen higher_low bar high, within six bars after pullback
families.invalid_structure: any bar after pullback with low < pullback low cancels; never widen stop
families.no_chasing: equal close is not a break; high alone not a close; expired/cancelled attempt not silently restarted

families.name: opening_range_failed_downside_base_reclaim_proxy
references: MarketGauge Trading the 10 OClock Bulls chapter6
families.key_level: low of six completed opening bars
families.target: high of same frozen initial range
families.parent: first subsequent completed close strictly below initial_range_low
families.base: the NEXT four consecutive five-minute bars after parent, excluding wide breakdown bar; each low >= parent.low
families.base_high: maximum high of those four bars, frozen at base end
families.confirm: first later close strictly above BOTH frozen base_high and initial_range_low in the next three bars
families.invalid_structure: any post-parent low < parent.low cancels; no shifting base or new low reset
families.control: EE-B-EARLY-RECLAIM: first subsequent close > initial_range_low no later than parent+7 bars, no base requirement; same original parent/session
families.comparison_limit: Different entry clocks; compare complete policy changes, not pure selection attribution. All parent/unknown counts retained.
families.does_not_claim: actual volume-at-price value area, absorption, or verified VWAP

families.name: reported_operating_profit_turnaround_continuation_proxy
families.information_delta: reported original current same-quarter operating profit >0, independently identified prior-year same-quarter original profit <=0; same currency/unit and consolidation basis
families.new_fact_is_not: analyst surprise, positive report title, or proof that the information was first disclosed by this periodic filing
families.input_contract: two original reported profit facts with receipt/source IDs, fiscal year/quarter, exact signed values, unit, consolidation basis, observation_end and available_at; current year = prior year+1 and same quarter
families.period_plausibility: fiscal_year label must be within one calendar year of observation_end.year; exact company fiscal-quarter mapping remains caller-authenticated and is not inferred from calendar month
families.event_window: caller-adjudicated first eligible session OPENING after both facts are available; known admitted facts must be available no later than session opening; historical completeness/earlier preliminary release remains explicit evidence limitation
families.parent: first completed close strictly above highs of previous five completed bars, after initial30 minutes
families.stop: minimum low of preceding five bars
families.target: entry-independent risk target 2R from signal close and fixed stop; actual entry must retain positive registered cost space
families.context: profit facts missing => unknown, never no-event or negative profitability; mismatch of units/period/basis => refusal
families.control: EE-C-WITHOUT-PROFIT-CONTENT: same parent, stop, target, clocks and common observable event context
families.actual_content_support: unverified; old ED title/date listing is not sufficient and must not be relabelled as content support

reentry.caller_evidence: prior attempt terminal_at and kind cancelled/closed; no reentry before that time, no actual fill claim
reentry.A: fresh completed close above BOTH prior frozen impulse high and key_level after prior terminal; then new pullback/higher-low/confirmation under same clock; no reset merely because price stays above T
reentry.B: fresh downward crossing after prior terminal: previous close >= frozen initial range low and new close < it; new four-bar base and confirmation; previous attempt unchanged
reentry.fresh_crossing_clock: new crossing bar end_at and available_at both strictly after prior terminal_at; previous comparison close may predate terminal, and crossing bar start need not follow terminal
reentry.C: no automatic second entry under same profit fact in v1; an additional content event is a separately registered follow-up, not invented here
reentry.account_admission: requires separate cash/flat/risk checks; kernel emits eligibility only, never an order

exits.scope: registered for later pure path adapter, not implemented by detector alone
exits.structural: first completed one-minute CLOSE <= frozen stop; observation end+2, first minute OPEN strictly after availability, capped at hold cap
exits.target: first completed one-minute CLOSE >= frozen pre-entry target; same delayed OPEN exit proxy
exits.response: after at least ten consecutive completed one-minute closes since entry have become available, when all those observed closes <= entry and latest close < entry, exit at next minute OPEN strictly after availability
exits.time_cap: entry+60 minutes OPEN, within original same-day close
exits.cap_equal_time_triggers: when the earliest possible delayed OPEN exit is at or after cap, cap absorbs it and the irrelevant CLOSE is not required; do not attribute an unconsumed trigger as a stop/target/response
exits.intraminute_touch: separate diagnostic only; simultaneous stop/target touch inside OHLC is unknown order; no assumed stop-level fill

cost_scenarios.basis: legacy fixed round-trip price-label assumptions; not certified current fees, dated taxes, spreads, slippage, impact or executable liquidity

missingness.known_absence: requires full contiguous expected causal prefix through cutoff
missingness.later_gap: cannot erase an earlier fully observed event

gates: full source and research-integrity independent review
prohibited: market-row reads by this pure module
